about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Zuppa Toscana Sausage Kale and Potato Soup
recipes.summary: Spicy Italian sausage soup with potato, kale and a splash of cream.
steps: Brown the sausage meat in the oil for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked through, then lift out.
Cook the onion and garlic in the fat for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the sliced potato, stock and chilli and simmer for 15 minutes until the potato is tender.
Return the sausage, add kale and cream and simmer for 5 minutes until the kale wilts.
notes: Food safety: sausage must reach 75°C with no pink.

recipes.title: Colombian Ajiaco Chicken and Potato Soup
recipes.summary: Three-potato Bogota soup with corn and chicken, served with capers and cream.
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion and spring onions in the water for 20 minutes until the chicken reaches 75°C, then shred it.
Add the diced potatoes, corn and herb and simmer for 30 minutes, until the potatoes break down and thicken the soup.
Return the chicken and season with salt.
Serve with cream, capers and avocado.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and show no pink.

recipes.title: Turkish Ezogelin Red Lentil and Bulgur Soup
recipes.summary: Warming red lentil, bulgur and rice soup with mint and chilli butter.
steps: Fry the onion in half the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in both pastes for 2 minutes until darker.
Add the lentils, rice, bulgur, water and salt and simmer for 25 minutes until everything is soft.
Heat the remaining oil with mint and chilli for 1 minute until it sizzles, and pour over each bowl with lemon.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Borshch with Beef and Dill
recipes.summary: Beetroot and cabbage soup with beef, finished with sour cream and dill.
steps: Simmer the brisket in the water for 1 hour 30 minutes, until tender, then shred and keep the stock.
Grate the beetroot and carrot and fry with the onion in the oil for 10 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and vinegar, then add to the stock with the potato and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the cabbage and beef and simmer for 8 minutes until the cabbage is tender.
Serve with sour cream and dill.
notes: Food safety: beef must reach 75°C throughout; chill leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Kerala Fish Moilee Coconut Soup
recipes.summary: Mild coconut curry soup with firm white fish, ginger and curry spices.
steps: Fry the mustard seeds, onion, ginger and chilli in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add turmeric, tomato and coconut milk and simmer for 8 minutes until slightly thickened.
Slip in the fish and cook for 5 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Finish with the lime juice and serve hot, until just warmed through.
notes: Food safety: cook fish until opaque and flaking; refrigerate within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Greek Fasolada White Bean Soup
recipes.summary: Greece's humble national soup of white beans, tomato, carrot and olive oil.
steps: Cover the beans with water, boil for 10 minutes, then drain.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery in half the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Add the beans, tomatoes, bay and water and simmer for 50 minutes, until the beans are completely tender.
Season with salt and stir in parsley and the remaining oil.
notes: Soak the beans overnight if you have time, which is not counted in prep time.

recipes.title: Shakshuka Verde with Spinach and Feta
recipes.summary: Green version of shakshuka with spinach, leek and herbs, eggs baked on top.
steps: Soften the sliced leeks in the oil for 6 minutes until tender.
Add garlic, cumin and spinach and cook for 4 minutes until wilted.
Stir in the parsley, make 6 wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 6 minutes until the whites are set.
Crumble over the feta and serve straight from the pan.
notes: Food safety: cook until the whites are fully set; firmer yolks for vulnerable eaters.

recipes.title: Bircher Muesli with Apple and Hazelnuts Dairy Free
recipes.summary: Soaked oats with grated apple, oat milk and toasted hazelnuts.
steps: Stir the oats and oat milk together in a bowl.
Grate in the apples and mix with the lemon juice, maple and cinnamon.
Cover and chill overnight until creamy.
Toast the hazelnuts for 3 minutes until golden and scatter over the bowls.
notes: Soak at least 6 hours, which is not counted in prep time.

recipes.title: High Protein Cottage Cheese Pancakes
recipes.summary: Soft cottage cheese and oat pancakes, about 25 g protein per serve.
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, oats, baking powder and vanilla until smooth.
Cook scoops in a lightly oiled pan for 3 minutes until set and golden underneath.
Flip and cook for 2 minutes until the centre is firm and cooked through.
Serve with sliced apple and honey.
notes: Food safety: cook until the middle is no longer wet.

recipes.title: Quinoa Tabbouleh Style Super Green Salad
recipes.summary: Herby quinoa with cucumber, edamame and a lemon dressing, high in plant protein.
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 400ml water for 15 minutes, until tender and the tails pop.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes until bright green.
Chop the herbs and cucumber finely.
Toss everything with the lemon, oil and salt.

recipes.title: Spiced Lentil and Roasted Carrot Salad with Tahini
recipes.summary: Earthy lentils with cumin carrots, rocket and a lemon tahini dressing.
steps: Simmer the lentils in water for 22 minutes until tender but holding shape, then drain.
Roast the carrots with the oil, cumin and salt at 220C for 30 minutes, until charred and tender.
Whisk the tahini with lemon and 3 tbsp water until pourable.
Toss the lentils with the carrots, rocket and sliced onion and drizzle over the tahini.

recipes.title: Patatas Bravas with Smoky Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Crisp roast potatoes with spicy smoked paprika tomato sauce and garlic mayo.
steps: Roast the potato cubes with 3 tbsp oil and salt at 220C for 40 minutes, turning once, until crisp and golden.
Fry the garlic, paprika and chilli in the remaining oil for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and vinegar and simmer for 12 minutes until thick.
Spoon over the potatoes and dollop with mayonnaise.

recipes.title: Greek Style Silverbeet with Garlic and Lemon
recipes.summary: Garlicky wilted greens finished with olive oil and lemon.
steps: Separate the stalks and leaves and slice the stalks thinly.
Cook the stalks in the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant, then add the leaves for 4 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Verde Argentine Herb Sauce
recipes.summary: Garlic, parsley and vinegar sauce for grilled steak.
steps: Chop the parsley and garlic finely.
Stir through the oregano, chilli, vinegar and salt.
Whisk in the oil and rest 15 minutes until the flavours blend.
notes: Rich in oil, so a spoonful goes a long way.

recipes.title: Hollandaise Style Yoghurt Lemon Sauce for Eggs
recipes.summary: Lighter creamy lemon sauce for poached eggs and asparagus.
steps: Whisk the yolks and lemon in a bowl over simmering water for 4 minutes until thick and pale.
Whisk in the melted butter slowly until glossy.
Fold in the yoghurt and warm for 1 minute without boiling.
notes: Food safety: heat the yolks until they thicken; serve at once and do not reheat.
